text.koneko_warden_guard.tamed: The Warden accepted the sculk offering. You can now summon a Warden stand; regularly use sculk on the Warden Idol with right-click to maintain trust.

text.koneko_warden_guard.only_one: You already own a tamed Warden.

text.koneko_warden_guard.no_guard: There is no Warden to recall at the moment.
text.koneko_warden_guard.already_summone: The Warden is already by your side.

config.koneko_warden_guard.title: Koneko Warden Guard
config.koneko_warden_guard.help: This setting will sync to the current server.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.koneko_wa: Gain the Warden's trust with sculk blocks, maintain trust through the Warden Idol, and use hotkeys to summon, recall, and command sonic boom attacks.
key.koneko.warden_guard.sonic: Command Warden Sonic Boom at Crosshair Target
text.koneko_warden_guard.trust_already: A Warden already trusts you. Use sculk on the Warden Idol with right-click to extend the duration.
text.koneko_warden_guard.idol_refreshed: Warden Idol maintained. Trust extended by approximately %s in-game days.
text.koneko_warden_guard.trust_expired: The Warden Idol has been left unmaintained for too long. Trust has faded, and the Warden stand has departed.
text.koneko_warden_guard.need_trust_firs: You need to feed sculk to a wild Warden first to gain its trust.
